name: Ring Modulator
author: Motion Audio
description: Multiplies the sound by a tone: bells, robots and metallic sci-fi textures. Low rates make a choppy tremolo.
code:
@sample
ph += freq / srate
ph -= floor(ph)
m = sin(2 * pi * ph)
outL = mix(inL, inL * m, amount)
outR = mix(inR, inR * m, amount)
